texts.about_this_item: Zubochistiki avocado dental chews for small-breed dogs (5 pieces) — a multifunctional treat with health benefits. Thanks to their porous structure these chews clean teeth very well. Fish oil is added, so they contain the omega-3 and omega-6 needed for healthy skin and coat. Rich in vitamins A, B and E and minerals.
